title: LA Colossal – Son Mai 05 (Seated)
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Chinese woman in her late 40s, black hair in a low polished bun with a gold pin, natural face with a gentle smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips spreading across the stool, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body Vietnamese son mai lacquer body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, not latex. Deep glossy black and red-brown lacquer with gold-leaf chrysanthemums, silver-leaf herons, and crackled white eggshell mountains. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Seated upright on a round lacquer stool, torso facing the camera, legs crossed at the knee, both hands resting lightly on her upper knee, elbows relaxed out to the sides. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Very high 8-inch red-brown lacquer platform Mary Jane stilettos with a gold buckle strap.
Nails: Extra long oval nails, red-brown with eggshell-white tips.

Background & Lighting: Vintage Hanoi parlor with lacquer screens, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm lamp key with raking side light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
